title: 1993 Fleer #296 Mark McGwire Oakland Athletics Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a set of two original 1993 Fleer Mark McGwire #296 trading cards featuring the Oakland Athletics player in Major League Baseball. These standard-sized baseball trading cards are made of card stock and are part of the base set for the 1993 Fleer collection. They are vintage items manufactured in the United States and are a valuable addition for collectors of sports trading cards, especially those interested in Mark McGwire and the Oakland Athletics.
